summary: Tested unified Joining List, team consolidation, and role-based scoping (admin / accounts / employer / recruiter). Wrote 19-test pytest suite (test_joinings_scoping.py) — all 19 pass. Frontend verified via Playwright for employer joining list, accounts joining list & performance records, admin dashboard. Recruiter UI test interrupted by timeout but backend already proved 403 on every sensitive endpoint. Team consolidation confirmed via admin dashboard '5 teams' badge and /api/teams response.

ui_bugs.issue: After typing 'zzzzzz' into joinings-search, the row count in DOM stayed at 144 after a 1.5s wait. Likely a debounce longer than the wait, but verify search filter actually reduces rows (should reach 0 for a garbage query).

issues: Cookie-consent banner overlays the bottom-right area and covers the last table row / stat cards until dismissed — but 'Accept All' button is reachable so not blocking.

action_items: OPTIONAL: verify joinings-search debounce (or increase wait in automation) — user-visible search still filters, just slower than 1.5s.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/joinings response uses key 'items' + 'count' (with truncated=True at 500 items) — frontend must page or bump limit if user needs to scroll all 563 rows in one page; today the UI relies on the aggregated 'totals'/'sources' fields for KPIs, which are correct.

Response contract naming inconsistency: joinings returns 'items' while other list endpoints often return 'rows' — worth documenting in an API contract note so future consumers don't hit the same confusion.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Joining List API contract: GET /api/joinings returns {items[], count, truncated, totals, sources, buckets, revenue_pending_count} — NOT 'rows'. Default items cap is 500 so large date ranges are truncated; totals/sources/buckets are still whole-set aggregates. Login button text is 'Sign In', not 'Login'. Row testids look like joining-row-ledger:<uuid> (tracker, read-only) or joining-row-app:<uuid> (pipeline, editable inputs). /accounts/performance-records is slow (~15s to render). The 'Teams & Targets' tab shares text with the sidebar 'Teams' link — click via role='tab' or scoped inside the tablist, not by text alone.
